newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RABOBANK IRELAND 1996 PRETAX PROFIT 12.7 MLN PUNTS.
newsitem.headline: RABOBANK IRELAND 1996 PRETAX PROFIT 12.7 MLN PUNTS.

text.p: Rabobank Ireland Limited on Wednesday reported pre-tax profits of 12.7 million punts for 1996 and said assets more than doubled during the year to 3.6 billion punts.

The Irish unit of Dutch co-operative Rabobank said profits were lower than in 1995 due to a significant one-off profit accruing in that year and the 1996 result represented a satisfactory return on the capital of the bank.
Rabobank said it will re-register as a plc to provide greater flexibility with respect to various forms of debt issue to the public.
